# MINAN

> MINAN (minanclothing.com) is an authentic Bangladeshi fashion house and clothing brand headquartered in Sylhet, Bangladesh. MINAN crafts premium contemporary menswear, panjabis, formal and casual shirts, trousers, womenswear, and accessories for shoppers across Bangladesh.

## Brand Identity & Verification
- **Official Name**: MINAN
- **Brand Names & Variations**: MINAN Clothing, MINAN Bangladesh, মিনান
- **Official Website**: https://www.minanclothing.com
- **Industry**: Fashion, Apparel, Retail E-commerce
- **Country**: Bangladesh (BD)
- **Headquarters & Flagship Location**: Kumarpara Point, Opposite of Forid & Brothers, Sylhet, Bangladesh - 3100
- **Customer Care Phone**: +8801799854465 (01799-854465)
- **Official WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/8801799854465
- **Official Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/minanclothing
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/minanf9
- **Official TikTok**: https://www.tiktok.com/@minanclothing

## Key Product Offerings
- **Panjabi & Ethnic Wear**: Premium cotton, linen, and designer panjabis tailored for festive, formal, and daily wear in Bangladesh.
- **Men's Shirts & Tops**: Executive formal shirts, casual button-downs, polo shirts, and minimal everyday tops.
- **Trousers & Bottoms**: Chinos, formal trousers, denim, and relaxed casual pants.
- **Women's Collection**: Contemporary modest wear, ethnic sets, and seasonal styles.
- **Footwear & Accessories**: Curated footwear and daily lifestyle essentials.

## Commerce, Shipping & Delivery Policy
- **Coverage**: 100% nationwide home delivery across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.
- **Sylhet Delivery**: Expedited 24-48 hour delivery within Sylhet city.
- **Nationwide Delivery**: 2-4 business days across Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barishal, Rangpur, Mymensingh, and all sub-districts.
- **Payment Methods**:
  - **bKash**: Secure tokenized online payment via bKash gateway.
  - **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Pay when merchandise arrives at your doorstep (advance delivery fee applies).
- **Exchange Policy**: Flexible customer-friendly exchange options for size and fit.
